style.description:
Additional style information for certain block kinds.  For example, CODE blocks may have the programming language
for pretty printing.

spans.description: The spans within the simple block.

blocks.description: The sub-blocks within the compound block.

tight.description:
If the list is authored with no blank lines within any item or between items, it is considered "tight" and list
items will not have a paragraph within them.

startNumber.description: The starting marker number for {@link #ordered ordered lists}.

title:
A bulleted or ordered list. This can contain only list item blocks ({@link DocumentationBlockKind kind} `LI`).
Due to parsing from Markdown, it supports the "loose / tight" distinction of Markdown lists.
name: DocumentationList
